void.$description: Anti Black. Primary ground. Most layouts start here.

carbon.$description: Carbon. The badge disc (from the original logo). Cards, panels.

graphite.$description: Graphite. Raised surfaces, dividers on dark.

bone.$description: Bone. Warm paper white for light layouts and print.

white.$description: Hero White. The mark, label boxes, headlines on dark.

ember.$description: Ember. Pressed / hover state of Ignition. Never as a fill on its own.

dusk.$description: Dusk. Photo duotone midtone (from the original sunset channel art).
